```{r echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}

# Print the processed transcript. Tabs and ASCII punctuation marks are written
# as numeric character references (e.g., '&#34;' for '"') so that Pandoc
# prints the text as it is, instead of reading characters such as '*', '#' or
# '[' as Markdown or making straight quotes curly.
codes = utf8ToInt(transcript())
escape = codes %in% c(9, 33:47, 58:64, 91:96, 123:126)
cat(ifelse(escape, sprintf('&#%d;', codes), intToUtf8(codes, multiple = TRUE)), sep = '')

```
